author: haiku
label: climb-04-01
changes: Merged the 'Core design rule' and the two 'follow from the brief' rules into one Summary, and cut the duplicate data-flow block; the flow now appears once, as a numbered list plus one diagram-form block.
Moved the idempotency-key and retry-policy explanations into the Terms section, so each is stated once instead of in the rules, the steps and the cross-cutting section.
Split the document into 'How the system runs' (runtime flow, state, failure table) and 'Rollout, in order' (build and ship steps), as the layout rule requires.

Replaced the per-step failure notes that repeated the same cases (service down, broker down, MailRelay down, redelivery, duplicate status) with one failure table, and kept only step-specific failure notes in the steps.
Merged the crash-during-send case and the 23-hour resend guard into one failure row, so the guard is explained where the failure is handled.
Shortened Step 1 to four confirmation items, and Step 2 to its effect and failure handling.
Shortened Step 3's schema list into grouped bullets and kept the same columns and gate.
Merged the Step 4 lease, resend guard and retention bullets, and dropped the repeated explanation of the ack window (kept once in the flow).
Shortened Steps 7 to 9 by stating the cutover mechanics once in Step 7 and pointing to it only as 'the same as Step 7', with the rollback restated in one line per step.
Merged the template-drift freeze into the Step 6 gate and the monitoring section, which previously repeated it, and kept the same freeze window (Step 6 until Step 10).
Merged the cross-cutting duplicate-send guarantee into one bullet, and kept the risk wording unchanged.
Kept the six open questions verbatim in substance, as the last section, and removed references to their numbers from the steps so no step needs them looked up.

Kept all gates, thresholds, timings (1/2/4/8-minute backoff, 5 attempts, 60 s lease, 23-hour guard, 60 s p99 gate, 3- and 7-day holds) and the emergency re-own rule unchanged in intent. No new mechanism was added.
